regime_context: Big Banks lead thematic momentum with perfect breadth (1.0) and moderate durability (0.68), remaining eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Base Metals & Copper is the challenger but with very low breadth (0.11). Rotation is broad and non-directional; the trend gate provides drawdown control but no return forecast.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: watch for breadth rising above 0.6 and durability bar exceeding 0.6 as a potential challenger theme; kill if breadth falls below 0.1 or remains below 0.3 for 10 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The Big Banks theme is the dominant, trend-eligible narrative with full constituent breadth and moderate durability. The absolute-trend gate keeps us exposed against trend breaks, historically reducing drawdowns. Crowding is elevated, warranting a size cap but not a fade. The overweight is conditional on continued trend eligibility and breadth, not on momentum rank.
evidence: Rank 1 with eligible status via absolute-trend gate
theses.dissent: Bank of Canada tightening or a housing-market downturn could trigger a sharp re-rating of bank earnings; the theme’s recent r10 is negative (-2.3%) and crowding (z=1.05) signals reflexive fragility.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks eligibility turns false or breadth drops below 0.5, the overweight is invalidated.
